notes: Harvest pool (season:harvest): the autumn trees, the pumpkin patch and corn and wheat fields, hay and sheaves, a fruit basket and a harvest feast. 'tier' is the catalog tier and can be used as event drop rarity (the Farmyard Corner is the single extremely-rare). Almost all grade B; the Scarecrow is grade C, kept because it is the harvest icon. A few of these pieces (the autumn trees and fields) live in the flora category, which another curator draws from first, so no other pool uses them; check for later clashes.
